newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-POLLOCK OUT OF TEST WITH STRAINED HAMSTRING.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-POLLOCK OUT OF TEST WITH STRAINED HAMSTRING.

text.p: South African fast bowler Shaun Pollock will take no further part in the second test against Australia after straining his left hamstring on the second morning on Saturday.
"Shaun will not bowl again. His hamstring is quite badly strained although he should be able to bat with a runner," said South African team manager S.K.Reddy early on Saturday.
Pollock bowled just two overs on Saturday morning when Australia resumed their first innings on 10 for one in reply to South Africa's total of 209.
Pollock removed the tourists' captain Mark Taylor for eight in his second over but then limped from the field with Australia on 13 for two.
